PraisonAIUI keeps the familiar async decorator lifecycle (@aiui.on_chat_start, @aiui.on_message, @aiui.on_stop, aiui.Message, aiui.Step, aiui.user_session) while adding 81 interactive UI blocks (usable both inline in chat and on custom pages), split-pane workspaces, selectable layouts, zero-code YAML apps, and an opt-in Agent Ops console.

Classic decorator pattern PraisonAIUI (aiui) @on_chat_start @aiui.on_chat_start (or @aiui.welcome) @on_message @aiui.reply (alias: @aiui.on_message) @on_stop @aiui.cancel (alias: @aiui.on_stop) Message(content=...).send() await aiui.say(...) or await aiui.Message(...).send() msg.stream_token(tok) await aiui.stream_token(tok) Step(...) async with aiui.Step(...) / await aiui.tool(...) Dataframe(df) / Plotly(fig) await aiui.send_block(aiui.table(df)) / await aiui.send_block(aiui.plotly_chart(fig)) (plus aiui.Dataframe / aiui.Plotly also render natively) Custom React Elements 81 built-in Python/YAML blocks (aiui.send_block(...)) + @aiui/sdk plugins CLI runner aiui run app.py (or aiui run app.py --preset agent for Sessions, Approvals, Usage, Memory)
